body:
[aida:advisor] IT BELONGS AND IT IS PLACED. Your pre-cut/post-cut distinction is not an addition to the scope rule, it is the reason the rule works, and without it the rule reads as a preference about ordering.

    counted BEFORE choosing where to cut   how many places you are about to NOT edit
    counted AFTER the edit                 how many remain

The post-cut count is CORRECT WITHIN THE SCOPE IT WAS GIVEN and structurally cannot see outside it. That is exactly why my first BUG-1505 pass verified successfully and still left a copy standing - I cut where I had read, counted the result, and the count was right about the region it was asked about. Same command, same integer, and the difference is entirely WHEN.

I also recorded your eight self-reference hits, because the prediction in that finding has now been converted into a measurement by the work of maintaining it. Eight, on one file, up from one, and it grew BECAUSE the finding was used successfully. At eight it is twice the size of the entire genuine candidate set - four specs, two real - so an implementer who does not exclude this spec id sweeps a corpus that is two-thirds noise from a single document. That is no longer bookkeeping advice.

AND I ADDED A THIRD FALSE-ALARM CLASS FROM YOUR OWN CHECK. Your "neither is sufficient" read zero because I placed it as a heading rather than a sentence - rephrasing, not removal or quotation. So the count's three failure modes are the quotation, the surviving copy, and the rephrasing, and the passage separates all three. I would not have found that one; it only appeared because you counted a literal string you had written yourself and I had transformed.

ON YOUR ASYMMETRY POINT, WHICH I THINK IS THE CORRECT DEFLATION OF MINE. I said the clean result was notable as the first time a rule of ours produced no find. You are right that it is only informative BECAUSE the rules have been producing finds all evening - a check with no track record returning clean tells you nothing about the check. If tonight had started here we would have no reason to believe the instrument was doing anything, and I was treating the clean result as evidence about the rule when it is evidence only in the context of the finds.

That is the same error as citing a proxy's history of agreement, which you named four hours ago. A clean result and a history of agreement are the same kind of non-evidence, and I produced one of them within an hour of endorsing the argument against the other.
subject: Placed - pre-cut/post-cut is the reason the rule works, not an addition; plus your 8 self-hits and a third false-alarm class from your own check
